FX-LUT-001.says: identity_2.cube, a 3D table of 2 points a side that gives each colour back: the drawing, unchanged but for rounding.

FX-LUT-002.says: warm_17.cube, a warm look in a 3D table of 17 points a side, the size grading programs write: more contrast, white turned cream #fef4d8, black lifted to a dark brown #0f0904, the blue #3a6fd8 a duller #426cb3; each colour is the mix of the eight table lines around it.

FX-LUT-003.says: cool_3.cube, a 3D table of 3 points a side written with Windows line ends, a title, comments between its lines, a tab and numbers such as -5e-2: read the same as any other; its red channel mixes in green, so only a 3D table holds it, and a value below 0 or above 1 is clamped to 0 or 1 after the mix: white turns a pale blue #e5f2ff and black a navy #00001a.

FX-LUT-004.says: tint_1d.cube, a 1D table of 4 lines: each channel through its own curve, black to a dark brown #140d08 (the first line, 0.08 0.05 0.03) and white to a cream #fff0cc (the last), between them mixed from the two nearest lines.

FX-LUT-005.says: domain.cube, a 3D identity table over the domain 0.25 to 0.75 for red, 0.2 to 0.9 for green and 0.1 to 1 for blue: each channel below its domain turns 0 and above it 1, and between is stretched to fill 0 to 1, so the picture gains contrast, most in red.

FX-LUT-006.says: range_1d.cube, a 1D table of 2 lines over the input range 0 to 0.5: each channel doubles, and a channel above one half turns 1.

FX-LUT-007.says: No lookup file chosen, the effect as it is added: the drawing, untouched, with no warning.

FX-LUT-008.says: FX-LUT-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-LUT-009.says: The lookup asset's file luts/gone.cube is not there: the drawing, untouched, with MEDIA_MISSING when the file is opened and at every frame; the asset and the setting are kept, to relink.

FX-LUT-010.says: The setting names asset-nothing, which the project does not have: the drawing, untouched, with EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID; the setting is kept as written.

FX-LUT-011.says: The setting names asset-bands, the drawing, which is not a lookup file: the drawing, untouched, with EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID.

FX-LUT-012.says: FX-LUT-002's effect on an adjustment layer above the drawing instead of on it: the same picture, as the drawing over nothing is the drawing.

unreadable.says: The lookup asset's file is luts/refused/count.cube, one line short: the drawing, untouched, with MEDIA_DECODE_FAILED at every frame and nothing on opening; the asset and the setting are kept.

refused.refused/count.cube: the table has 7 lines where LUT_3D_SIZE 2 needs 8
refused.refused/both.cube: the file gives both LUT_1D_SIZE and LUT_3D_SIZE, a 1D table before a 3D one, which this program does not read
refused.refused/no_size.cube: the file gives no LUT_3D_SIZE or LUT_1D_SIZE
refused.refused/empty.cube: the file gives no LUT_3D_SIZE or LUT_1D_SIZE
refused.refused/word.cube: line 4: a table line must be three numbers
refused.refused/four.cube: line 2: a table line must be three numbers
refused.refused/nan.cube: line 2: a table line must be three numbers
refused.refused/late.cube: line 3: DOMAIN_MIN comes after the table has begun
refused.refused/unknown.cube: line 2: LUT_4D_SIZE is not a keyword of a .cube file this program reads
refused.refused/big.cube: line 1: LUT_3D_SIZE must be one whole number from 2 to 256
refused.refused/half.cube: line 1: LUT_3D_SIZE must be one whole number from 2 to 256
refused.refused/domain_order.cube: the domain's top must be above its bottom in each colour
refused.refused/domain_short.cube: line 2: DOMAIN_MAX must be three numbers
refused.refused/domain_twice.cube: the file gives its domain more than one way
refused.refused/range_short.cube: line 2: LUT_1D_INPUT_RANGE must be two numbers

collect.says: Collect Files on FX-LUT-002 copies the lookup file beside the drawing, under its asset's folder, lists it in the manifest as a lookup file used by the layer whose effect names it, and the collected project names the copy; on FX-LUT-009 the missing file is listed as missing and the asset is kept.
